description:
PURPOSE: Re-sends the SMS code of a prepared booking.
WHEN TO USE: Only when the customer says the SMS from prepare_booking did not arrive.
WHEN NOT TO USE: Not after a wrong code (ask the customer to re-type it) and not to start a new booking.
REQUIRED: confirmation_id. SIDE EFFECTS: sends one SMS (max 1 per minute, 3 per 30 minutes per phone; otherwise error rate_limited with retry_after).

session_id.description: Optional. session_id from the previous result, if you have it. The server also recovers the session from quote_id / slot_id / confirmation_id / customer_grant.

name: resend_confirmation_code

error.description: Stable machine-readable error id when success=false, e.g. missing_required_fields, unsupported_postcode, no_availability

success.description: true = operation done / data returned; false = see error

title: Wyślij kod ponownie
